title: Repair Excel File – Recover Data From a Corrupted XLSX
description: Recover data from a damaged Excel file in your browser: values, formulas, merged cells and column widths saved into a new .xlsx. Free, no upload.
heading: Repair an Excel file
subtitle: Read a damaged Excel file leniently and save its sheets' data into a new, clean .xlsx file, in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Repair an Excel file that Excel says is damaged or that won't open: the .xlsx, .xls or .ods file is read leniently, and every sheet's values, formulas, merged cells and column widths are written into a new, clean .xlsx file. You see how many sheets and cells were recovered before you download it. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Lenient reading
features.text: The file is read with tolerance for damage, so the data that is still there can be saved.

features.title: See what was recovered
features.text: The number of sheets and cells recovered is shown before you download.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is repaired by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

stepsTitle: How to repair an Excel file

steps.title: Choose the damaged file
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop the .xlsx, .xls or .ods file that won't open.

steps.title: Check what was recovered
steps.text: See how many sheets and cells were read from the file.

steps.title: Download the repaired copy
steps.text: Download the new .xlsx file and open it in Excel or any spreadsheet app.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I repair a corrupted Excel file?
faq.answer: A corrupted Excel file can often be saved by reading what is still readable and writing it into a new workbook. Excel's Open and Repair, in the Open dialog, tries this first, and LibreOffice Calc can sometimes open a file Excel refuses. On this page, choose the file and download a clean .xlsx with the sheets' values, formulas, merged cells and column widths.

faq.question: What is recovered?
faq.answer: The values, formulas, merged cells and column widths of every sheet that can still be read. The number of sheets and cells recovered is shown.

faq.question: Is the formatting recovered?
faq.answer: No. Formatting, charts, pictures, pivot tables and macros are not recovered; the data is. A file that is not a spreadsheet at all can't be repaired.

faq.question: How can I check the repaired file?
faq.answer: Open it in the Excel viewer on this site, or in any spreadsheet app, and look through the sheets.

faq.question: Is my original file changed?
faq.answer: No. A new .xlsx file is written and downloaded; your original file stays as it was.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
